etchmiadzin-cathedral.title: Etchmiadzin Cathedral
etchmiadzin-cathedral.period: Traditionally founded 301-303 CE, when Armenia became the first state to adopt Christianity; the standing structure is a 5th-century (c. 480s) rebuild on the original site, with later additions
etchmiadzin-cathedral.story: The oldest cathedral in the world and the mother church of the Armenian Apostolic Church - a real, physical anchor for the Church's spread beyond the Roman Empire and Armenia's claim to be Christianity's first national church.

catacombs-priscilla.story: Genuine early Christian devotional art from underground Rome - a fresco of a shared meal, one of the oldest visual depictions of Christian communal worship. Art, not a photo of any individual, from the era of the persecuted and hidden Church.

cluny-abbey.title: Cluny Abbey, surviving fragments

cluny-abbey.story: Physical anchor for the great Benedictine monastic reform movement that reshaped Western European Christianity.
